caption.zh: 开启 Mocha 对话：在项目对话框输入研发目标并发起请求。
caption.en: Start a Mocha conversation: enter a research goal in the project chat and submit the request.

caption.zh: Mocha 完整流程示例：从输入研究任务到查看分析结果。
caption.en: Full Mocha workflow example: from a research request to analysis results.

caption.zh: 查看 Task：打开任务列表并检查各项计算的运行状态。
caption.en: Review Task: open the task list and check computation status.

caption.zh: 查看 Mocha 结果：阅读任务完成后的分析与输出文件。
caption.en: Review Mocha results: read the completed analysis and inspect output files.

caption.zh: 打开 Workspace：定位对话中生成的结果文件。
caption.en: Open Workspace: locate result files generated in the conversation.

caption.zh: 查看同源蛋白：检查匹配结果、序列一致性和 Reference。
caption.en: Review homologs: inspect matches, sequence identity, and Reference links.

caption.zh: 区域注释：点选功能区域，在三维结构中高亮；Clear 清除选区。
caption.en: Region annotations: select a functional region to highlight it in 3D; use Clear to remove the selection.

caption.zh: 单残基注释：点选残基，在结构中定位对应位置。
caption.en: Single-residue annotations: select a residue to locate its position in the structure.

caption.zh: 抗体编号：切换编号方案，核对 CDR 与链的标注。
caption.en: Antibody numbering: switch numbering schemes and review CDR and chain annotations.

caption.zh: 互作网络：在 Table 与 2D 视图间切换。
caption.en: Interaction network: switch between Table and 2D views.

caption.zh: 小分子二维互作：点选连线查看作用类型及距离。
caption.en: Small-molecule 2D interactions: select an edge to inspect interaction type and distance.

caption.zh: 小分子残基互作：点选氨基酸查看相关互作。
caption.en: Small-molecule residue interactions: select an amino acid to inspect its contacts.

caption.zh: 互作表格：点选一条互作，在三维结构中定位原子与残基。
caption.en: Interaction table: select a row to locate the atoms and residues in 3D.

caption.zh: 抗体–抗原二维互作：查看界面残基及互作距离。
caption.en: Antibody–antigen 2D interactions: inspect interface residues and contact distances.

caption.zh: 抗体–抗原互作表：核对链、残基、互作类型与距离。
caption.en: Antibody–antigen interaction table: check chains, residues, interaction types, and distances.

caption.zh: 突变打分：通过 View 预览、Download 下载各维度 CSV 结果。
caption.en: Mutation scoring: use View to preview and Download to export CSV results.
